name: io.github.olano-ai/mcp-singapore
title: Singapore MCP by Olano
description: Singapore public data, transport, rail, property, business, economy, weather, and analytics.

examples.name: Research a neighbourhood
examples.description: Combine public property, rail, address, amenity, and weather context for a Singapore area.

examples.name: Research a company
examples.description: Search public ACRA entities and add official Singapore business and economic context.

examples.name: Explore MRT and LRT
examples.description: Search station complexes, lines, codes, exits, interchanges, and nearby stations.

examples.name: Analyse public time series
examples.description: Align Singapore economic series by period and produce transparent statistics and charts.

environmentVariables.name: DATA_GOV_SG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional data.gov.sg API key for production limits.

environmentVariables.name: ONEMAP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional OneMap token for geocoding, routing, themes, and address-based rail lookup.

environmentVariables.name: LTA_DATAMALL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional LTA DataMall Account Key for dynamic transport APIs.

environmentVariables.name: OLANO_SG_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional private directory for the persistent public-response cache.

environmentVariables.name: OLANO_SG_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional aggregate tool profile: all, mobility, property, business, economy, civic, or finance.
